# Rule: Inline accessor references a renamed internal member

_Canonical rule slug:_ `inline-accessor-renamed-pimpl-member`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A header-inline accessor names an internal member that was renamed, so already-inlined consumer code refers to a member that no longer exists.
